Parameters

Same seed + same settings = same image.

Using Ink Studio

Create a screen

Choose a generator on the left. Adjust its parameters on the right; sliders update the preview as you move them. For exact values, use the number fields and press Enter or click outside the field.

Randomize changes the selected generator’s seed and parameters. Reset restores its default parameters while keeping the current seed. New seed changes the pattern without changing its parameters.

Same seed + same settings = same image. To recreate a design later, keep its generator, seed, and parameter values. The BMP filename includes the generator and seed.

Preview and export

E-ink adds warm paper color, grain, and slight edge softening for preview only. Raw 1-bit shows the black-and-white image used for export. Curves can look stepped because each pixel is either black or white.

Save BMP downloads a clean 528 × 792 pixel, 1-bit BMP. Preview effects are never included. Reaction–diffusion may take a moment to simulate; export becomes available when the image is ready.

Use it on your X3 with CrossPoint

  1. Create a folder named .sleep at the root of your SD card and copy your BMPs into it. A folder named sleep also works.
  2. On the reader, choose Settings → Display → Sleep Screen → Custom.
  3. Put the reader to sleep. CrossPoint randomly chooses one image each time it sleeps.

A file named sleep.bmp at the SD card’s root overrides the image folder. Move or rename it to use the folder instead. If automatic sleep keeps showing the book page, turn off Quick Resume on Timeout in Display settings.

On a Mac, press ⌘ ⇧ . in Finder to show hidden folders such as .sleep.
